Complete [[Borlis Pass]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Light the [[Storm Beacon|storm beacons]] along [[Borlis Pass (outpost)|Borlis Pass]].
* *BONUS* Kill the [[Ice Drake]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Borlis Pass#Walkthrough|Borlis Pass]] mission.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;Zaishen Mission
: ''"Storms up in Borlis Pass have extinguished the beacons. A small band of hardy individuals would be enough to relight the way and assure safe passage for future travelers."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
{{anomaly|The 2 [[Frostfire Dryder]]s that accompany the Ice Drake also have to be killed to complete the first bonus objective.}}
